fato_historico: 1996: Ethiopian Airlines Flight 961 is hijacked, then crashes into the Indian Ocean off the coast of Comoros after running out of fuel, killing 125.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a gentle reminder of the precious nature of our journey. Just as travelers seek safe harbors across vast oceans, consider anchoring yourself in gratitude. It is a good time to reflect on your inner resilience and find calm, even when life feels like an unpredictable flight. You have the strength to navigate any storm with grace.
frase_do_dia: May your spirit soar high and always find a gentle place to land safely.
significado_numero: A powerful master number representing intuition and spiritual insight for your path.
conselho: Focus on the present moment and cherish the safety of your current surroundings.
